text: Land preparation (ការរើបចំដី). Ideal soil pH is 6-7.5, with good structure for water infiltration and moisture retention. Land preparation steps: clear crop residue and weeds from the field, sun-dry the cleared soil to reduce pest and weed pressure, then plow/harrow 2-3 times to break the soil into a fine, loose, well-aerated tilth. Raised beds are formed 25-30cm high and 100-120cm wide. Basal fertilizer is then applied before sowing — either compound NPK 15-15-15 fertilizer at roughly 200 kg/ha, or organic/animal manure — before the bed surface is raked smooth and level, ready for sowing. Seeds are soaked in water for 1-2 hours before sowing, then drained and air-dried for 3-4 hours, with a light seed treatment/fungicide coating recommended as part of good practice.
